records.intent: Establish premium mood while making one hero product the visual authority.

layout.desktop: 12-column grid; copy spans 4 columns left; product spans 5 columns right; contextual image bleeds behind both

responsive.mobile_behavior: background becomes a dedicated media block above copy; product remains foreground; badge moves below headline
responsive.tablet_behavior: Retain the 12-column relationship with a narrower copy measure and product reduced to roughly 80 percent scale; keep the contextual background behind both and stack only below the mobile breakpoint.

image_guidance.background: A contextual, brand-specific still life that includes the actual product category cues, surface, light, and material language; no generic abstract gradient.
image_guidance.product: High-resolution packshot or hero object with clean silhouette and enough negative space for the copy plane.
image_guidance.prompt_frame: [brand category] product hero still life, [material cues], [lighting], [palette], art-directed negative space on the [left/right], premium ecommerce campaign photography

records.motion: Slow 4px product reveal on entry; no continuous animation.

hero_architecture.text_placement: left copy plane with controlled measure
hero_architecture.product_placement: foreground product in right-side visual plane
hero_architecture.background_requirements: contextual material/still-life world tied to the product category
hero_architecture.cta_placement: below subheadline in the HTML copy plane
hero_architecture.overlay_behavior: soft vignette or directional tonal layer only where needed for copy contrast
hero_architecture.typography_behavior: display-led hierarchy with restrained label and generous whitespace

breakpoints.desktop: 12-column grid; copy spans 4 columns left; product spans 5 columns right; contextual image bleeds behind both
breakpoints.tablet: Retain the 12-column relationship with a narrower copy measure and product reduced to roughly 80 percent scale; keep the contextual background behind both and stack only below the mobile breakpoint.
breakpoints.mobile: background becomes a dedicated media block above copy; product remains foreground; badge moves below headline

records.intent: Pair a contextual lifestyle scene with a clearly merchandised product column.

layout.desktop: 50/50 split; left visual is edge-to-edge; right copy is vertically centered inside narrow content measure

responsive.mobile_behavior: context image first, then copy, then product image as a compact card or inline object
responsive.tablet_behavior: Keep the 50/50 split through tablet when contrast is reliable; reduce media and copy gutters, then move the product image below the copy before mobile if the text measure becomes cramped.

image_guidance.context: Show the product in use or in a recognizable environment tied to the category and audience.
image_guidance.product: Use a clean product image with a crop that preserves packaging or silhouette.
image_guidance.prompt_frame: [actual product category] in [specific environment], [audience cue], natural directional light, premium campaign photography, clear focal subject

records.motion: Crossfade between context and product on scroll only if the media is not required to understand the copy.

hero_architecture.text_placement: vertically centered copy in the non-media column
hero_architecture.product_placement: product in a compact foreground or inline object adjacent to copy
hero_architecture.background_requirements: recognizable product-in-use environment or category context
hero_architecture.overlay_behavior: none by default; local tonal correction only on image
hero_architecture.typography_behavior: clear heading/body hierarchy with moderate measure

breakpoints.desktop: 50/50 split; left visual is edge-to-edge; right copy is vertically centered inside narrow content measure
breakpoints.tablet: Keep the 50/50 split through tablet when contrast is reliable; reduce media and copy gutters, then move the product image below the copy before mobile if the text measure becomes cramped.
breakpoints.mobile: context image first, then copy, then product image as a compact card or inline object

records.intent: Create immediate campaign impact with one full-bleed contextual image and a protected text zone.

layout.desktop: 100vw media plane with copy pinned to a 4-column safe area; image uses an art-directed crop
layout.alignment: left or right edge based on detected negative space

responsive.mobile_behavior: use dedicated portrait crop; move copy into a solid or translucent block when contrast is not reliable
responsive.safe_area: copy occupies at most 58 percent of mobile image height
responsive.tablet_behavior: Keep the full-bleed crop and choose the safest negative-space side dynamically; reduce copy width and strengthen only the directional overlay needed for legibility.

image_guidance.campaign: The actual product or its use context must be a recognizable subject. Compose negative space on the chosen copy side; do not add illegible text to the image.
image_guidance.prompt_frame: premium [category] campaign, [actual product/use context], subject weighted to [opposite side], [palette], [lighting], tactile editorial commercial photography, no text

records.motion: Image remains still; use a 1.02 scale transition on entry only.

hero_architecture.structure: full-bleed campaign image with protected text safe area
hero_architecture.text_placement: left or right edge chosen from detected negative space
hero_architecture.product_placement: dominant subject/product placed opposite the copy safe area
hero_architecture.background_requirements: actual product or use context with deliberate negative space
hero_architecture.cta_placement: directly below text in safe area
hero_architecture.overlay_behavior: directional gradient/vignette permitted only as a legibility correction
hero_architecture.typography_behavior: short headline with high contrast and limited supporting copy

breakpoints.desktop: 100vw media plane with copy pinned to a 4-column safe area; image uses an art-directed crop
breakpoints.tablet: Keep the full-bleed crop and choose the safest negative-space side dynamically; reduce copy width and strengthen only the directional overlay needed for legibility.
breakpoints.mobile: use dedicated portrait crop; move copy into a solid or translucent block when contrast is not reliable

records.intent: Signal energy and confidence through an offset composition with a product breaking the grid.

layout.desktop: 12-column offset grid; oversized type spans 7 columns, product overlaps columns 7–12, accent marks may escape container
layout.alignment: left copy with deliberate vertical offset

responsive.mobile_behavior: type scales down first; product becomes full-width after headline; remove nonessential accents
responsive.tablet_behavior: Preserve the offset grid with approximately half the desktop offset; reduce type scale and product overlap, then collapse decorative accents before the mobile breakpoint.

image_guidance.product: Use a product image with a dynamic but truthful angle; preserve logos and product identity.
image_guidance.background: Use a category-relevant environment, surface, or campaign texture, never a random abstract backdrop.
image_guidance.prompt_frame: high-energy [category] campaign, actual product prominent, [material/environment], hard directional light, high contrast, bold negative space, no text

records.motion: Product enters from a 12px offset; accents do not loop.

hero_architecture.text_placement: left, offset, oversized HTML display type
hero_architecture.product_placement: foreground product breaking the right-side grid boundary
hero_architecture.background_requirements: category-relevant surface, scene, or campaign environment
hero_architecture.cta_placement: below supporting text, aligned to copy edge
hero_architecture.overlay_behavior: solid or tonal surface preferred; graphic accents are optional and nonessential
hero_architecture.typography_behavior: compressed or oversized display with short copy and strong label contrast

breakpoints.desktop: 12-column offset grid; oversized type spans 7 columns, product overlaps columns 7–12, accent marks may escape container
breakpoints.tablet: Preserve the offset grid with approximately half the desktop offset; reduce type scale and product overlap, then collapse decorative accents before the mobile breakpoint.
breakpoints.mobile: type scales down first; product becomes full-width after headline; remove nonessential accents

records.intent: Make the product and its proof points the first readable story for a direct-response launch.

layout.desktop: Contained two-column composition; left column stacks copy and benefit row, right column centers product with controlled shadow or surface

responsive.mobile_behavior: product first with copy below; benefit row becomes a horizontal scroll or two-by-two grid
responsive.tablet_behavior: Retain a two-column product/copy relationship with a smaller product plane and a compact benefit row; stack in the mobile layout.

image_guidance.product: True-to-color packshot or cutout with enough resolution to inspect the product at large scale.
image_guidance.prompt_frame: premium ecommerce product photography of [actual product], [surface/material], controlled soft shadow, clean silhouette, accurate packaging, no text overlay

records.motion: Product image may subtly sharpen or rise on entry; benefits appear as a short stagger.

hero_architecture.text_placement: left copy stack above benefits and action
hero_architecture.product_placement: large centered product plane on the right
hero_architecture.background_requirements: truthful packshot/cutout on a considered product surface
hero_architecture.overlay_behavior: controlled shadow or surface treatment; no decorative overlay needed
hero_architecture.typography_behavior: benefit-led hierarchy with concise headline and scannable proof

breakpoints.desktop: Contained two-column composition; left column stacks copy and benefit row, right column centers product with controlled shadow or surface
breakpoints.tablet: Retain a two-column product/copy relationship with a smaller product plane and a compact benefit row; stack in the mobile layout.
breakpoints.mobile: product first with copy below; benefit row becomes a horizontal scroll or two-by-two grid

records.intent: Introduce a collection through a visual rail of multiple products without defaulting to a generic grid.

layout.desktop: Text occupies upper-left band; product rail crosses lower half with 4–6 varied card crops; optional background anchors the palette

responsive.mobile_behavior: copy remains above a snap-scrolling rail; first card is 78vw wide and shows continuation
responsive.tablet_behavior: Keep the horizontal rail with three visible items and snap points; retain the text band above the rail and reduce overlap before mobile.

image_guidance.items: Use a coherent image system across products, varying crops or colors only when the collection itself supports it.
image_guidance.background: Keep background contextual to the collection season or material world.
image_guidance.prompt_frame: [collection theme] campaign environment, [product category] products coherently styled, premium ecommerce art direction, open text space, no text

records.motion: Rail scrolls only by user gesture; card hover may lift by 2px.

hero_architecture.structure: headline band over a horizontal product rail
hero_architecture.product_placement: multiple products in a lower visual rail
hero_architecture.background_requirements: collection-season or material-world context when used
hero_architecture.cta_placement: within the text band before or beside the rail
hero_architecture.overlay_behavior: background tonal treatment only; cards remain readable
hero_architecture.typography_behavior: collection label plus concise headline and supporting line

breakpoints.desktop: Text occupies upper-left band; product rail crosses lower half with 4–6 varied card crops; optional background anchors the palette
breakpoints.tablet: Keep the horizontal rail with three visible items and snap points; retain the text band above the rail and reduce overlap before mobile.
breakpoints.mobile: copy remains above a snap-scrolling rail; first card is 78vw wide and shows continuation

records.intent: Lead with a magazine-like visual statement for brands where worldview is as important as product.

layout.desktop: Large media sits above a narrow editorial headline block; title may overlap the lower media edge by one baseline

responsive.mobile_behavior: remove overlap; media precedes title with fixed crop and controlled text measure
responsive.tablet_behavior: Keep media above the editorial title with a reduced overlap depth; use a narrower text measure and remove overlap before mobile.

image_guidance.masthead: Use a real campaign or contextual scene with strong composition and editorial restraint. The product should be present or logically implied by the scene.
image_guidance.prompt_frame: editorial magazine masthead for [brand category], [actual product or use context], refined composition, tactile materials, controlled palette, no typography

records.motion: No parallax by default; use a restrained fade-in for caption and actions.

hero_architecture.structure: large masthead image followed by editorial title block
hero_architecture.text_placement: below or lightly overlapping media edge on desktop
hero_architecture.product_placement: product present in scene or logically implied by the real campaign context
hero_architecture.background_requirements: real campaign/editorial image with strong visual point of view
hero_architecture.cta_placement: after dek/byline when a CTA is needed
hero_architecture.overlay_behavior: no overlay by default; preserve image integrity
hero_architecture.typography_behavior: magazine-like title scale with narrow dek measure

breakpoints.desktop: Large media sits above a narrow editorial headline block; title may overlap the lower media edge by one baseline
breakpoints.tablet: Keep media above the editorial title with a reduced overlap depth; use a narrower text measure and remove overlap before mobile.
breakpoints.mobile: remove overlap; media precedes title with fixed crop and controlled text measure

records.intent: Deliver a high-contrast campaign moment with decisive type and a single action.

layout.desktop: Dark full-bleed visual with oversized type anchored to one edge; product or model crosses the opposing third

responsive.mobile_behavior: switch to portrait crop and copy-first stack if the subject competes with type; keep contrast at all times
responsive.mobile_copy: solid dark panel or gradient only as needed for legibility
responsive.tablet_behavior: Retain the high-contrast campaign field and edge-aligned type; reduce headline scale, preserve the product/model focal third, and strengthen the safe-area overlay only when required.

image_guidance.campaign: Use actual product, model, or relevant environment with directional lighting and visible material detail; never a generic black texture.
image_guidance.prompt_frame: dark high-contrast [category] campaign, actual [product/model/use context], directional flash or hard light, deep shadows, premium editorial energy, no text

records.motion: One-time type reveal and subtle grain opacity; never loop a noisy effect.

hero_architecture.structure: dark full-bleed campaign field with opposing subject and type
hero_architecture.text_placement: edge-aligned HTML type in protected contrast zone
hero_architecture.background_requirements: actual product, model, or relevant night/campaign context
hero_architecture.cta_placement: under short supporting line in copy zone
hero_architecture.overlay_behavior: dark tonal overlay and optional restrained grain for legibility, never a decorative glass panel
hero_architecture.typography_behavior: compressed bold type, short line count, high contrast

breakpoints.desktop: Dark full-bleed visual with oversized type anchored to one edge; product or model crosses the opposing third
breakpoints.tablet: Retain the high-contrast campaign field and edge-aligned type; reduce headline scale, preserve the product/model focal third, and strengthen the safe-area overlay only when required.
breakpoints.mobile: switch to portrait crop and copy-first stack if the subject competes with type; keep contrast at all times

records.intent: Make a distinctive ingredient, material, or technical mechanism the lead visual and message.

layout.desktop: Three-zone composition: ingredient/context image, centered product, and copy in a narrow column; lines or labels may connect zones

responsive.mobile_behavior: context and product become stacked images with connector graphic removed; proof note follows copy
responsive.tablet_behavior: Keep the contextual image, product, and copy as a three-zone composition when readable; collapse the connector graphic and reduce to two zones before mobile.

image_guidance.ingredient: Show the actual ingredient/material or a credible contextual representation tied to the product; avoid microscopic fantasy imagery unless scientifically accurate and useful.
image_guidance.product: Use a clean, truthful product image with consistent light direction.
image_guidance.prompt_frame: art-directed [ingredient/material] and [actual product] composition, tactile macro detail, [brand palette], premium scientific editorial photography, no text

records.motion: Connector line draws once only when it improves comprehension; respect reduced motion.

hero_architecture.structure: three-zone ingredient/context, product, and copy composition
hero_architecture.text_placement: narrow copy column connected to the visual system
hero_architecture.product_placement: center or foreground product with truthful silhouette
hero_architecture.background_requirements: actual ingredient/material or credible category context tied to the product
hero_architecture.cta_placement: after proof note in copy column
hero_architecture.overlay_behavior: connector lines or labels remain HTML/graphics, not baked into imagery
hero_architecture.typography_behavior: educational hierarchy with numbered or labeled proof

breakpoints.desktop: Three-zone composition: ingredient/context image, centered product, and copy in a narrow column; lines or labels may connect zones
breakpoints.tablet: Keep the contextual image, product, and copy as a three-zone composition when readable; collapse the connector graphic and reduce to two zones before mobile.
breakpoints.mobile: context and product become stacked images with connector graphic removed; proof note follows copy

records.intent: Lead with lived-in social evidence for brands whose credibility comes from community and use.

layout.desktop: Copy occupies a stable column while 3–5 UGC tiles form a collage around a product or review pull quote

responsive.mobile_behavior: show one lead UGC tile plus a horizontal rail of supporting tiles; copy remains a separate HTML block
responsive.privacy: include creator permissions and fallback crop behavior
responsive.tablet_behavior: Reduce the collage to two lead tiles plus a controlled rail; keep the HTML copy column separate and preserve permission/state labels.

image_guidance.ugc: Use authentic, permissioned customer imagery with varied but coherent lighting; do not fabricate testimonials or imply unverified outcomes.
image_guidance.prompt_frame: Not for generated UGC: use supplied, permissioned customer assets. If unavailable, substitute a product-in-use campaign scene and label it accurately.

records.motion: Tiles can settle into place on entry; no random rotation after load.

hero_architecture.structure: copy column plus permissioned UGC collage and product cue
hero_architecture.text_placement: stable HTML copy column separate from UGC tiles
hero_architecture.product_placement: product appears as a clear anchor among or beside UGC
hero_architecture.background_requirements: permissioned real customer imagery or truthful campaign fallback
hero_architecture.overlay_behavior: labels may sit over tiles only when accessible text fallback remains
hero_architecture.typography_behavior: short direct headline with community proof line

breakpoints.desktop: Copy occupies a stable column while 3–5 UGC tiles form a collage around a product or review pull quote
breakpoints.tablet: Reduce the collage to two lead tiles plus a controlled rail; keep the HTML copy column separate and preserve permission/state labels.
breakpoints.mobile: show one lead UGC tile plus a horizontal rail of supporting tiles; copy remains a separate HTML block

records.intent: Orient visitors into a multi-category store through distinct visual entry points.

layout.desktop: Editorial title block above 2–4 large category portals with distinct crop and label treatment
layout.alignment: title centered or left; portals form an image-led matrix

responsive.mobile_behavior: category portals become a vertical list or snap rail; label remains HTML and always readable
responsive.tablet_behavior: Use a two-column portal matrix with readable HTML labels; keep the title above the matrix and move to a rail or stack on mobile.

image_guidance.category_images: Each category image should show the category's actual products or a recognizable use context; vary scenes, not just color filters.
image_guidance.prompt_frame: editorial [category] scene for [brand], actual product class visible, distinct context from sibling categories, premium commercial photography, no text

records.motion: Portal image scale on hover only; labels do not move independently.

hero_architecture.structure: title block above a category portal matrix
hero_architecture.text_placement: HTML title and intro above portal tiles
hero_architecture.product_placement: category products or recognizable category scenes inside each tile
hero_architecture.background_requirements: distinct category-specific product/use context for each portal
hero_architecture.cta_placement: optional view-all action in heading band
hero_architecture.overlay_behavior: light tonal correction for labels only; labels remain HTML
hero_architecture.typography_behavior: clear category labels with restrained headline

breakpoints.desktop: Editorial title block above 2–4 large category portals with distinct crop and label treatment
breakpoints.tablet: Use a two-column portal matrix with readable HTML labels; keep the title above the matrix and move to a rail or stack on mobile.
breakpoints.mobile: category portals become a vertical list or snap rail; label remains HTML and always readable

records.intent: Focus attention on a time-bound launch while preserving product and brand clarity.

layout.desktop: Campaign image and product compose a strong field; countdown is a contained utility row below the headline

responsive.mobile_behavior: countdown becomes a full-width row under headline; deadline is rendered as accessible text, not color alone
responsive.fallback: When deadline expires, replace countdown with availability or waitlist state
responsive.tablet_behavior: Retain the campaign/product relationship and place the countdown directly beneath the copy; keep deadline state and primary action visible without pulsing.

image_guidance.campaign: Use the actual launch product or credible campaign context; do not use a generic clock, abstract gradient, or false scarcity visual.
image_guidance.prompt_frame: launch campaign for [actual product], [season/event context], premium ecommerce photography, clear product silhouette, intentional space for copy, no text

records.motion: Countdown updates as data; no attention-seeking pulsing. Use a single state change when the deadline passes.

hero_architecture.structure: campaign/product hero with utility countdown row
hero_architecture.text_placement: copy-led zone adjacent to campaign/product visual
hero_architecture.product_placement: actual launch product or truthful campaign subject
hero_architecture.background_requirements: real launch context tied to the actual product and deadline
hero_architecture.overlay_behavior: tonal correction only; never use pulsing or decorative urgency overlays
hero_architecture.typography_behavior: short launch headline with explicit status hierarchy

breakpoints.desktop: Campaign image and product compose a strong field; countdown is a contained utility row below the headline
breakpoints.tablet: Retain the campaign/product relationship and place the countdown directly beneath the copy; keep deadline state and primary action visible without pulsing.
breakpoints.mobile: countdown becomes a full-width row under headline; deadline is rendered as accessible text, not color alone
